judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing the acceptance test and updating one spec file, completely failing to modify `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to implement the usage accumulation logic or update the `OrchestratorHooks` type signature. As a result, the newly added tests in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` will fail against the unedited orchestrator implementation. Furthermore, the candidate did not update `CHANGELOG.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, or `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`, and left an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file in the repository. While the acceptance tests and DoD show a clear understanding of the requirements, the actual implementation is missing.
